sourceDecisionQuestions.question: The source names a debris dumpster, but archived French uses generic benne à déchets. Choose the site-appropriate dumpster/container term and ensure the disposal destination is not broadened to all waste.

The English source specifies shingles while Spanish tejas can also mean roof tiles. Archived bardeaux may imply asphalt or wood shingles depending on locale. Preserve the source job material consistently in disposal instructions after qualified source/trade review.
Source deck is the roof deck before underlayment. Archived support may be broader; choose the regional structural roof-deck and underlayment terms before scoring or narrating the cleanup step.

Source card names the magnetic nail sweep operation; Reader asks for completion of picking up nails with a magnet. Archived ramassage magnétique is less explicit about the tool and scope. Align card, Reader and Say target without inventing a clearance certification.
The source says run the magnet over the yard and report nail pickup. Confirm local ground-control scope; this dialogue alone is not a complete debris, sharp-object or public-area safety procedure.

Source speaking only assigns one worker to shingles and another to old nails. Archived speaking adds ground-zone isolation and cleanup confirmation. Keep those safety/domain notes separate until qualified review determines what belongs in the lesson and authored modes.
